findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: asksteps_publish_form, asksteps_search_docs, asksteps_analyze_pdf · Private data: asksteps_list_templates, asksteps_assign_site, asksteps_import_pdf, asksteps_update_publication, asksteps_create_form, asksteps_analyze_pdf, asksteps_create_funnel · Public sink: asksteps_assign_site, asksteps_publish_form, asksteps_import_pdf, asksteps_update_publication, asksteps_update_funnel, asksteps_update_form · Destructive: asksteps_delete_form, asksteps_update_funnel, asksteps_update_form, asksteps_get_form_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: asksteps_publish_form, asksteps_search_docs, asksteps_analyze_pdf · Private data: asksteps_list_templates, asksteps_assign_site, asksteps_import_pdf, asksteps_update_publication, asksteps_create_form, asksteps_analyze_pdf, asksteps_create_funnel · Public sink: asksteps_assign_site, asksteps_publish_form, asksteps_import_pdf, asksteps_update_publication, asksteps_update_funnel, asksteps_update_form · Destructive: asksteps_delete_form, asksteps_update_funnel, asksteps_update_form, asksteps_get_form_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
